business_impact: Customers can create tickets but ticket-detail reads return HTTP 500 when APP003_TICKET_EVENT_LIMIT contains an unsupported non-integer runtime value.
reproduction: Deploy the APP-003 configuration-aware exercise image with its default valid setting and confirm ticket-detail reads succeed. Recreate only the API runtime with APP003_TICKET_EVENT_LIMIT=not-a-number using the temporary Compose override. The same release/image remains healthy at /health/ready, but GET /api/tickets/<id> returns HTTP 500 and the API logs a structured configuration_error. Correct the setting to a supported integer and recreate the API on the same image; the original request returns HTTP 200.
